title: Explicit scalar sections resolution models and their cohomology comparisons
statement: Let k be a field and f:X -> Spec(k) a scheme morphism, and F an O_X-module. Fix the library injective resolution I of F using the recorded enough-injectives structure. Define K to be the global-sections complex of I followed by restriction of scalars along scalarMap f top, and define A=K extended by zero along the natural-number embedding into the integers. For every negative p, A^p is zero. In natural degree n the composite of the zero-extension homology isomorphism, the exact-scalar-restriction homology isomorphism and the inverse injective-resolution comparison gives a k-linear equivalence H^n(A) -> scalarCohomology f F n. No quasi-coherence, compactness or affine diagonal is required.

source.place: Cohomology, Tag 01DZ; replacement of the factor-model construction preceding Varieties equation 33.29.1.1

proof.text: Construct I with Mathlib injectiveResolution and the recorded enough-injectives instance. Apply globalSectionsComplex, restrictScalars termwise and extend by embeddingUpNat. These are actual constructions, not unspecified existence witnesses.
For p<0 there is no natural number n with n=p in the integers. Apply Mathlib HomologicalComplex.isZero_extend_X. This is the delivered complete Lean proof.

Compose Mathlib extendHomologyIso, ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso for exact scalar restriction, and the inverse isoRightDerivedObj, and apply ModuleCat.Iso.toLinearEquiv. The delivered definition picardScalarModelEquiv constructs this comparison with no new proof holes.
